articles.title: Mangoes sold at Walmart recalled because of Salmonella risk
articles.description: Panorama Produce is recalling 302 boxes of mangoes because they may be contaminated with Salmonella. The recalled fruit was distributed in the following states from Aug. 10 through Aug. 21: Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania, and sold in Walmart stores. articles.title: Hundreds sick and two dead in UK Salmonella outbreaks
articles.description: Two people have died and almost 500 have been infected in a trio of Salmonella outbreaks in the United Kingdom since 2025.
